title: Unit Event — A Sad Farewell at the Curtain Call — Episode5 Unexpected Words

meta.Event: A Sad Farewell at the Curtain Call
meta.Event Outline: The next ambassadorial performance is going to be the last one?! Wonderlands×Showtime is staggered to hear the news, but is followed by an offer to do a joint performance with a highly regarded theme park that puts on the best shows in Japan. As chaotic practices ensue, Rui is approached by a certain person...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, very good!
Let's try the next scene with you two swapping roles!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Okay! That means I'll be playing Alfred.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“Wh-Where am I?
I require positioning data for this area.”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: “Here? It's the farm my grandpa started out here on the frontier, Mr. Robot! We found you collapsed on the ground!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“I am not a robot. I am an android.
My name is Alfred Hawking.”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: “Alfred...? Then, I'll call you Al!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “...? Why use a nickname?”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
“Why?
Umm... Because we want to be friends with you!”

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member A
rows.Line:
“Hehe. We mean no harm.
Also, you're quite a mess. Let's get you cleaned up, shall we...?”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
...
Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: For this scene, can you try bobbing your head left and right as much as possible?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wh-Why?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You seemed to have gathered yourself too quickly, considering you collapsed on the ground just a second ago. So, I'd like for you to converse in a way that shows you haven't fully regained your balance.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Emu, I'd like for you and your family to interact with him in a way that shows you're all doing your best but also recognize that something is not quite right with him.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Okay!
That sounds like fun!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hnng...!!
“Wh-Where am I?! What is this place?!”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
“Huh?! Why are you swaying so much?!
Wait, can you not talk unless you do?”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “I require positioning data for this area!”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Tsukasa, don't forget that you're an android!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: A-Always with the impossible demands!

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: “Target eliminated...”

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member A
rows.Line:
“Good progress.
He should be ready for the front lines in no time.”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
“B-But...
Do you think he's actually going to be effective?”

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member A
rows.Line: “As his drill instructor, that is entirely up to you. Your goal is to make him ready for battle in a month's time.”

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: “Orders, Sergeant Willis.”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “You seemed so much more human when you first arrived here...”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “Alas, you're but an android.”

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: “Yes. I am an android.”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “Silence. Return to your standby area.”

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: “Understood.”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Asahi, a word.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You've certainly been putting an acting clinic on for us... However, since we'll be performing outside, I'd like to mix things up a little.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Specifically, I'd like for you to say, “Yes. I am an android,” as loudly as you possibly can.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Huh? As loudly as I can?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. I'd like to make this scene a little more comical for the audience by having it appear as though the volume regulator for your voice is broken...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: After that, by switching back to a serious tone, it'll make this conversation more impactful.

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member A
rows.Line:
I see...
It'll keep everyone guessing.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
That sounds interesting!
Let's give it a try!

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
“YES!!!!!!
I AM AN ANDROID!!!!!!!!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Gah!!!!
He's almost as loud as Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Nene, stay focused!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Right...
“Wh-Why are you shouting?!
Is the volume regulator for your voice broken or something?!”

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
“YES!!!!
THAT IS CORRECT!!!!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
“Grr...! Where is it...?!
Okay, how's this?!”

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: “Thank you very much, Sergeant Willis.”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
“Ugh... You're such a pain!
Are you really a state-of-the-art android?!”

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: “I am an android.”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “Silence. Return to your standby area.”

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: “Understood.”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Okay, let's go with that...
Also, Nene, well done.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
I already knew...
But this show really is a lot of fun.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Tsukasa, Emu and Nene are all performing according to my directions while doing their best to keep up with everyone from ArcLand.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Tsukasa in particular is doing a wonderful job of learning how to play a role that doesn't entirely suit him...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (However...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Rui! Can we talk...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, of course...
How can I help you?

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Shouldn't we decide who's going to be playing which role soon? We don't have much time left until our show.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, as fun as it is to see Tsukasa and Asahi play both roles, we sort of need you to make a decision soon.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Who gets to be who?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe. Your timing couldn't be better.
That was exactly what I was just thinking about.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (First, Alfred, since he's the central character of this story...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (He goes through a process of developing real emotions, so playing him will require a delicate touch.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (However, I'd also like for him to connect with the audience by adding a more human element.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The role of Alfred...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Will be played by... Asahi.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Well, I suspected as much...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Asahi was perfect in every aspect.
It genuinely felt like I was speaking to an android.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Precisely...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Also, I came to the conclusion that I needed someone who can present the process of developing real emotions in an elegant manner.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Which is why I chose Asahi.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, I completely agree with your decision...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Which means I am to play the role of Bartlett!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes...
I'm looking forward to seeing a good performance from you, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Thank you for entrusting me with such an important role. I promise to do my absolute best.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Thank you as well.
I'll be looking forward to seeing your Alfred.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now that I know I'm going to be playing Bartlett, I'll need to start practicing the final scene in earnest.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Right. The scene following the battle is probably this play's most important one, so let's both do our best, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, let's!!
The day before the show
Main Street

rows.Speaker: Shop Clerk
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Okay...
Thank goodness I was able to get my hands on these.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: To think that we'd run out of flower confetti for the final scene. I doubt any of us were expecting that.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I was supposed to keep an eye on that, so I apologize for making you come with me like this. Thank you as well, Asahi.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
No, it's my pleasure!
Also, I'm glad we were able to buy what we needed, so let's head to the station.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Tomorrow's finally the big day...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: This past month went by so fast.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, it did...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Are you worried about the final scene, Tsukasa...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hm? Oh, is it that obvious?
Something about it just isn't sitting right with me.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
It's such a moving scene...
I mean, Bartlett starts to gain emotions because Alfred manages to connect with him. But I just can't quite get it right.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: You've done everything you could up until now, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: We worked on our acting together and you went through the trouble of asking everyone about how to make your performance more compelling. Again, you've done everything you could, so you should have more confidence in yourself.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, you're right...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
No.
I think you can do more, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
You're a future star, no?
You should be able to handle that scene without any issues.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So, I say keep fighting until the very end.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: While we were shopping, I was considering what is still missing from your performance.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I began wondering if your talent for expressing yourself was actually holding you back.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If you found a way to hold back your thoughts and feelings... Then let just a little bit eke out during that scene... Would you mind practicing that tonight?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, hold my feelings back and let a little out...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Okay...!
I'll try practicing that when I get home!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Which means I should go now!
I'm sorry, Asahi, but I need to leave!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Okay!
Get home safe!

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: See you tomorrow, Tsukasa...!

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: You seem to trust Tsukasa quite a bit.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, I do.
Also...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I believe it's a director's duty to ask a little too much of their actors sometimes.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
I agree...
A show can only happen when you trust and believe in one another.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Precisely.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Now, we should also make our way to the station.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Yes, let's...
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Hm? Asahi hasn't said anything for a while now. Is something wrong...?)

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Rui...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: I know this is going to feel very sudden.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: And I know it's the day before our show, but I need to ask you this...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: How would you like to work at ArcLand?

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: You're still in high school, so you'd probably be hired as a part-timer... But I have a feeling that they'd make you a full employee in no time.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So... You're headhunting me?

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Yes, that's one way to put it...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Seeing you in person convinced me...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: With you, I have a feeling that we'd be able to put on a show that brings everyone in the world together... Like the way Tom did...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: As a director, you're bold and not afraid to ask others to do some wild things...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
But that excites me.
I'm constantly at the edge of my seat wondering what you're going to say or how you're going to respond next.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: That's why I want to work alongside you, Rui...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I greatly appreciate what you just said, but...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: I'm confident that your addition will lead to the rest of us becoming better actors.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: And you becoming a better director.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: The Center Theatre at ArcLand is a venue where only those with the potential to become world-class stars are able to perform.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: I'm sure directing such a cast would be unbelievably fun for you since you'd be able to put on shows beyond your wildest imagination... Shows that can bring the world together...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: So, how does working with us at ArcLand sound?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I really wasn't expecting to be asked to work at ArcLand...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Few directors would ever be considered for such an offer...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (And in terms of my dream...)

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
I'm sorry...
I know this is very sudden and a lot to process. To tell you the truth, I wasn't planning on asking you here...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: So, you don't have to give an answer right now. Please let me know once you've had some time to think about it.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay, understood...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Again, I apologize for surprising you like this. Anyway, I'll see you tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Okay.
See you tomorrow...
